rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches the codebase's conventions and repurposes the existing byte-level comparison logic.
rationale.edge_cases: Flawlessly handles percent-encoding discrepancies and empty suffixes by enforcing exact-remainder matches.
rationale.scope: Strictly addresses the suffix stripping requirement and cleans up the now-dead 'reverse' function without unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Extracting the matching logic into 'pathPrefixMatchLen' makes both the prefix and suffix operations very easy to understand.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles byte slicing and bounds checking; the worst-case O(N*M) loop is completely safe for bounded URI path lengths.
rationale.maintainability: Brilliantly avoids the high complexity of parsing percent-encodings backwards, resulting in a clean and easy-to-maintain design.
